newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu up on better earnings prospects.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu up on better earnings prospects.

text.p: Shares in Finnish metals and mining company Outokumpu Oy jumped in active trade on Tuesday on improved earnings prospects the group gave in its 1996 report on Monday, brokers said.

At 1155/0955 GMT, Outokumpu traded at 89.50 markka, up 5.10 markka or over six percent in lively 19 million markka volume. It earlier touched a six-month high of 90.00 markka, in demand both from domestic and overseas investors, brokers said.
"Players have now digested Outokumpu's 1996 report and realised, that even though the figures were weak, the company's prospects are good," said one.
He referred to Outokumpu's comments that its prospect have improved due to better market conditions and the stronger dollar.
Outokumpu on Monday reported a 229 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax for 1996, down from 1.48 billion markka in 1995.
